## Bramble Foods opens new distribution hub and eyes expansion

31st July 2026

Kieran Howells

Bramble Foods has opened a new 67,000 sq ft national distribution centre in Market Harborough as the family-owned fine food supplier prepares to expand its workforce.

The LDC-backed business has moved into Lancaster House at Airfield Business Park, a purpose-built facility developed by Leicestershire County Council.

The site will become Bramble Foods’ main UK distribution hub, increasing its warehousing and stockholding capacity as it expands its product range and customer base.

Bramble Group, which includes Whitakers Chocolates, The Bay Tree and Lings, currently employs around 300 people and expects the new facility to support the creation of up to 50 skilled roles over the coming years.

Long-serving employee opens new site

The centre was officially opened by Steve Heighton, who is celebrating 50 years working alongside the Foster family and Bramble Foods.

# Congratulations to Kwiksave Logistics Inc. on the grand opening of its new Burlington headquarters! · 2026-08-11T00:00:00+00:00

Congratulations to Kwiksave Logistics Inc. on the grand opening of its new Burlington headquarters!

The family-run business has officially opened the doors to its new 90,000 sq. ft. facility at 3100 Mainway, marking the largest investment in the company's history and a significant milestone in its continued growth.

From humble beginnings as a one-room operation in a Mississauga home to a 16,000 sq. ft. location on Harvester Road in 2017, Kwiksave Logistics has grown into a trusted final-mile logistics provider, distributing orders across the Greater Toronto Area.

Founded by Matthew and Maryam Sabet and now led by their children, Shariar, Rameen and Parisima, the company continues to build on a strong family legacy. During the ribbon cutting, the family reflected on their gratitude to their parents for laying the foundation for the business and shared their excitement for the opportunities Burlington offers as they continue to grow.

We're proud to celebrate this milestone and look forward to seeing Kwiksave Logistics continue to thrive in Burlington.

#### 20,119-square-foot facility brings company leadership and 75 employees together at Corporex’s CirclePort development

ERLANGER, Ky. (Aug. 20, 2026) — Verst Logistics has opened a new 20,119-square-foot office in Northern Kentucky, bringing its executive leadership and 75 employees under one roof as the third-party logistics provider continues its national expansion.

Verst, in partnership with Northern Kentucky-based real estate investment and development firm Corporex, held a grand opening and ribbon-cutting for the new Verst Logistics Excellence Center at Olympic Corporate Center II at CirclePort in Boone County.

The Class A office facility was designed to support the logistics company’s growth strategy and includes advanced audiovisual technology, an operations Logistics Hub and a large company lounge. The space is intended to increase collaboration among teams while supporting customer service and future growth.

# FST Logistics Expands Central Ohio Presence with New West Jefferson, Ohio Facility 

Dublin, OH – FST Logistics, a leading third-party logistics provider specializing in temperature-controlled transportation, retail consolidation, warehousing and supply chain solutions, is proud to announce the expansion of its Central Ohio footprint with the opening of a new facility in West Jefferson, Ohio. The new location adds 343,500 square feet of warehouse space to FST’s growing network and strengthens the company’s ability to support customers’ growth throughout the Midwest and beyond. 

The expansion provides additional capacity for FST to support the evolving needs of its customers, while creating opportunities to serve new customers seeking strategic warehousing and distribution solutions in Central Ohio. The facility features 38 dock doors, two drive-in doors, 40-foot clear height, 254 parking spaces and 85 trailer parking spaces, providing the infrastructure and capacity needed to support a wide range of customer operations.
